captions.caption: A soldier sits inside a helicopter, looking out the open door at the landscape.
The soldier continues to observe the terrain as the helicopter flies.
The helicopter travels over a vast, open desert area.
The soldier looks out of the helicopter door while wearing a helmet and headset.
The helicopter's rotor blades are seen spinning at the top of the frame.
The soldier remains seated, watching the ground pass by below.
The soldier adjusts their position, keeping an eye on the landscape.
The soldier reaches for the controls of the mounted machine gun.
The soldier begins firing the heavy machine gun out of the helicopter.
Continuous fire from the machine gun is seen as the soldier targets the ground.
The soldier fires several bursts from the heavy weapon.
Muzzle flashes are visible as the gun fires rapidly.
The soldier maintains a steady aim while firing the machine gun.
The helicopter continues to fly as the soldier fires at targets below.
The soldier fires another long burst from the machine gun.
Spent shell casings eject from the side of the heavy weapon.
The soldier stops firing and looks out at the results.
The soldier takes a brief pause before resuming observation.
The view shifts to a different soldier sitting in an open helicopter doorway.
The soldier looks out over a grid of agricultural fields.
The helicopter flies over a developed area with various structures.
The soldier remains at the door, observing the terrain below.
The camera perspective changes to a soldier near a multi-barrel minigun.
The soldier sits by the minigun, looking out at the desert landscape.
The helicopter flies over a flat, arid region.
The soldier keeps their hand near the minigun's firing mechanism.
The soldier watches the ground as the helicopter maneuvers.
The soldier continues to scan the area from the open door.
The helicopter's movement over the desert is visible.
The soldier reaches out and begins to operate the minigun.
The soldier begins firing the minigun with a high rate of fire.
The barrels of the minigun spin as it fires continuously.
The soldier maintains fire, directing the minigun towards the ground.
A steady stream of fire is directed from the helicopter's minigun.
The soldier stops firing and checks the weapon.
The soldier looks out at the landscape after the firing sequence.
The camera shows a view of the minigun and a rocket pod attached to the helicopter.
The helicopter flies alongside a steep, rocky cliffside.
The soldier's hand is seen on the grip of the minigun.
The helicopter banks to the right, following the contour of the mountains.
The camera focuses on the minigun and its ammunition feed system.
The helicopter continues its flight through the rugged mountain terrain.
The soldier looks out of the helicopter, monitoring the environment.
The helicopter maneuvers through a narrow valley or pass.
The landscape below is dry and mountainous.
The camera angle shifts back to a soldier with a heavy machine gun.
The soldier aims the heavy machine gun out of the helicopter door.
The soldier begins firing the machine gun at targets on the ground.
Muzzle flashes and smoke are visible as the weapon is fired.
The soldier fires sustained bursts from the heavy machine gun.
The helicopter flies over a desert landscape while the soldier fires.
The soldier continues to track a target and fire the machine gun.
The soldier maintains a high level of focus while firing the weapon.
The soldier stops firing and looks out at the target area.
The helicopter maneuvers away from the firing position.
The soldier remains vigilant, looking out of the open door.
The helicopter flies over a series of rocky hills and ridges.
The soldier keeps the heavy machine gun ready for further action.
The helicopter continues its flight path across the desert.
The soldier looks out at the horizon as the helicopter flies.
